name: Mors
desc: A fruit beverage in a deep red color, highly popular with young women in Snezhnaya for its pleasing sweet-and-sour taste. Wild-picked berries are slowly simmered over low heat, then crushed and strained. The resulting liquid is then mixed with honey and a little sugar before being left to cool and served.

value.text: Restores 28% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 620 HP every 5s for 30s.
